text:
maya: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to add Brazil (sa-east-1) and MENA (me-1) rows to the regional availability matrix and to clarify data residency notes. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
liam: Thanks — can you paste the exact legal phrasing you used for Brazil? Legal asked for a 'data processed in-region when requested' clause.
maya: Kopied from PR: 
```
Brazil (sa-east-1): Supported. Data residency available on request for Dedicated & Private. For Hosted, logs and metadata may be processed outside the country unless residency add-on is enabled. Contact sales for residency contracts.
```
liam: hmm we should avoid "logs and metadata" wording in public docs. Legal prefers "request-level data handling" or something less specific. I'll drop a suggested edit.
anna: timeline? We need this in the release notes for next Tuesday; also need the SDK snippets updated that show region header example. Current python sample still uses `region="eu-west-1"`.
ben: I can update the SDK snippet. Proposed curl + python examples: 
```
# curl
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: sa-east-1" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hi"}'

# python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=TOKEN, region="sa-east-1")
client.generate("hello")
```
maya: perfect — can you also add a short migration note for Dedicated customers who previously used `geo` header? we deprecated `geo` last quarter.
ben: will add a one-liner and a link to the migration guide.
docs-bot: CI checks passed for docs PR #492 — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/8712345 ✅
samir: quick ask from support — add an FAQ blurb for customers asking if embeddings are stored in-region; short answer should be yes for Dedicated/Private, hosted depends on tier.
liam: I'll reword the Brazil line to remove "logs" and add the residency add-on bullet. pushing edit now.
maya: thanks, @liam and @ben. Can someone do a final pass for copy tone? I'm out after 4pm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
anna: I can do it after the standup. Also check internal link targets — there was a 404 on /residency/faq earlier, make sure we point to /residency/overview.
maya: noted. tagging @samir for support confirmation before merge. :thumbsup:
